2607.10963.title: Efficient Online Proportional Sampling with Applications to Smoothed Online Learning
2607.10963.paper_summary: We study the problem of efficient online proportional sampling from a high-dimensional domain under a $σ$-smoothed adversary, where the sampling distribution is induced by a dynamically evolving weight function defined over a sequence of piecewise-structured partitions. This setting captures a broad range of applications, including principal-agent games (e.g., pricing and contract design), and algorithm configuration and parameter tuning. The central challenge is maintaining an efficient data structure as the induced partition grows increasingly complex over time -- naively, the number of subregions can grow as $O(t^d)$ by round $t$ in $d$ dimensions. We design a data structure that supports efficient updates and proportional sampling while avoiding the cost of explicitly maintaining this exponential growth, where the discontinuities are structured from axis-parallel hyperplanes. Under a $σ$-smoothed adaptive adversary, we prove a tight $O(\sqrt{σT})$ bound on the depth of our data structure, and an $O(\log T)$ bound under a random-order adversary -- to our knowledge, the first such results for this class of problems. We apply this framework to online learning with piecewise-structured rewards, obtaining efficient no-regret algorithms under both full-information and bandit feedback, with provable sublinear regret guarantees.
2607.10963.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究在 $σ$-平滑對手下，從高維領域進行高效在線比例抽樣的問題，其中抽樣分佈是由定義在一系列分段結構劃分上的動態演變權重函數所引發的。這種設置涵蓋了廣泛的應用，包括主代理遊戲（例如，定價和合約設計）以及算法配置和參數調整。中心挑戰在於隨著引發的劃分隨時間變得越來越複雜，維持一個高效的數據結構——天真地說，在 $d$ 維中，到第 $t$ 輪時，子區域的數量可以增長到 $O(t^d)$。我們設計了一個數據結構，支持高效的更新和比例抽樣，同時避免明確維持這種指數增長的成本，其中不連續性是由軸平行的超平面結構化的。在 $σ$-平滑自適應對手下，我們證明了我們的數據結構深度的緊湊 $O(\sqrt{σT})$ 界限，以及在隨機順序對手下的 $O(\log T)$ 界限——據我們所知，這是針對這類問題的首個此類結果。我們將這一框架應用於具有分段結構獎勵的在線學習，在全信息和強盜反饋下獲得高效的無後悔算法，並提供可證明的次線性後悔保證。
